faces.f: King or herder, the maggots care not.

"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

"Femeref was guided by the wisdom of the Council of Voices. But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

"The ceremony ended with a voice from the shadows, a voice with vast, ominous power."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

"The foul entities of the Uuserk swamp had never before dared to spread their influence to the very heart of Zhalfir."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

Whatever follows life is incurable.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it."
—Kaervek

"The night stalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."
—Kaervek

"Of the six who went down the Uuserk Trail to scout ahead, one returned. She clawed at her eyes and nostrils and sobbed with horror. I was curious about what she saw, but we chose another path."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

"I no longer believe in a final resting place."
—Shauku, Endbringer

"A zombie's bed must be a lumpy one or he wouldn't leave it so often."
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

Embrace the Harbinger
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"

"But I signed nothing!"
—Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage

"If the curse does not strike you dead, question your soul."
—Kaervek

"We realized the bog had not given up a soul but had come to claim a new one."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

"The finest offering of night is not stealth but daring."
—Tetlok, Breathstealer

"It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory."
—Jolrael

"In your final breath you still have something to offer Phyrexia."
—Afari, *Tales*
Eternal life brings eternal hunger.

"I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

The rich's heirs often thank them after death . . . but preferably not in person.
—Suq'Ata epigram

You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

To keep the dead so others may live.
—Shadow Guild maxim
Good help is hard to dig up.

"They exist only so long as the living take no notice."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

"Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life."
—Kaervek

"The flesh is a casket for the soul."
—Shauku, Endbringer

There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."
—Kaervek

"Life for life: this is the immutable law."
—Panya, Granger Guildmage

Zhalfir's destiny rings in tempered steel.
—Armorer Guild maxim

"The trollish game of push-fall inspired this impressive tactic."
—Sidar Jabari

"Tell me . . . have you ever sung the Song of Blood?"
—Purraj of Urborg

I live without food, stand without leg, wound without force, and am harder to fight than to kill. What am I?
—Femeref riddle
There is only so much a person may be buried with.
Even the lion envies the lark.

"Any day that I ride my horse up to my ankles in the remains of my enemies is a good day."
—Akin, seasoned askari

"I dance the nothing dance, / Feet in the air, knives in the ground."
—Femeref chant

"Dragonfire forged me a warrior."
—Rashida Scalebane

"Fetch the pestridder, Paka—we've got dwarves in the rutabagas!"
—Jamul, Femeref farmer

A dwarf's life belongs as much to the land as to the dwarf.
—Creed of the Stonethrow Clan

"Big one I, One big eye. One-eye see Two-eye die!"
—Traditional cyclops chant
A hefty price is no guarantee of quality merchandise.

Want all, lose all.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader
Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.

"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"
They talk a good fight.

"Pathetic—like I wouldn't know a goblin painted up to look like a dwarf!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

"I see a great victory and rivers of blood. And . . . hmm, looks like a spleen."
—Grishnak, goblin soothsayer

"Can they *do* that?"
—Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words

"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'"
—Akin, seasoned askari

The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown
"Inhale. Kill. Exhale."

When you've been chased by a dragon, you run from every lizard.
—Suq'Ata saying

"Its burning power is more elusive than shade on the Unyaro Plains, more perilous than the horn of a rhino."
—Akin, seasoned askari
Many mages have been consumed by their work.

"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."
—Kaervek
When the other soldiers of Zhalfir fall, the askaris will yet stand.

"Blow, fiery wind, / strip illusion from the eye. / Blow, fiery wind of truth."
—Femeref chant

"There are times solid ground gives precious little comfort."
—Talibah, embermage

"What rainbow could possibly come of this rain?"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"Air hot with sulfur. / Earth heaves beneath me. / Could it be the mountain / ate something bad?"
—Dwarven mining song

Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift.
—Suq'Ata saying

"The curious merely amass knowledge. The ambitious use it."
—Telim'Tor

"Execution awaits the dissenter."
—Kasib ibn Naji, *Letters*
The mountain's voice shouts us all down.

"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*
Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

"Defiantly, the young cyclops popped the brushwagg into his mouth. His cheeks suddenly puffed, his eye bulged, and he was forced to agree with his elder."
—Afari, *Tales*

"In the Mwonvuli you must divide your attention between what hangs overhead and what lies underfoot."
—Sidar Jabari

Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way.
—Femeref adage
Thus does nature assert herself.

"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course: they have no faith to guide their darts."
—Nuru, Femeref archer

"More armies have been lost in the confusion of the jungle mists than to any battle."
—Jolrael
Five hundred years to grow—barely a minute to eat.

"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

Hyenas laughing—what's the joke?
—Femeref phrase meaning "that's not funny"

Leave no mouth agape, no stomach unfilled.
—Granger Guild maxim

"What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?"
—Jolrael
Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

"Be like the meerkat, my daughters: ever vigilant, true to your own, and wary of strangers."
—Nabil Alamat, Suq'Ata merchant
Better a fierce thunderhead than a sky filled with locusts.
No two see the same Maro.

"The lion drank that lake right up! In thanks, he gave Siti the power to speak with lions and make them leave the goats alone."
—Afari, *Tales*

"The few of us who survived were denied entry to our camp for two days—so like the pox were the marks we bore."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

"I've never *heard* growth before."
—Gowon, Femeref herder

"Death is not a debt I am yet willing to pay."
—Purraj of Urborg

Better to fight the sand for a few hours than to sleep beneath it forever.
—Suq'Ata truism

"I have hidden from the machinations of Zhalfir for centuries. Why should I join *your* campaign?"
—Jolrael

"If magic is your crutch, cast it aside and learn to walk without it."
—Teferi
In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

"An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests. Even during the civil war, the guilds stood together, a testament to the wisdom of Teferi."
—Afari, *Tales*

"After the storm, I found a sea turtle dying on the sands, a blade of grass driven through its shell."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

Victim of the two-toed faerie
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "broken"

"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands."
—Kamau, "Proper Passage"

"Much can be learned from the bees about dying for a cause."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"Enchant me with your tale-telling. Tell about Tree, Grass, River, and Wind. / Tell why Truth must fight with Falsehood, and why Truth will always win."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"
The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.
Sometimes the wise ones wove their magic into living plants; as the plant grew, so grew the magic.

"I will tell my father's stories . . . . How the elephants trampled the leopard cub, and its father, though he knew, killed nine goats instead."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels."
—Afari, *Tales*

"Omens lie in this early harvest's fruit."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

"In all my years I've only met one mage who successfully trapped a djinn—and none who tried and failed."
—Talibah, embermage

"It's filthy work, planting them."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

"Life is a resource that should belong only to the strong."
—Shauku, Endbringer
The fire breathes while the air burns.
Life and death are two faces of the same coin.
"Hmmm—midnight snack."

"Our guardian levies a tax on all traders. Wise travelers pay with a minimum of fuss."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat
Like some foul herdbeast, it grazes on the dead.

"The hazerider danced in the thunderstorm and sang to its music."
—Afari, *Tales*

"You eat plants; I eat plants. You eat beasts; I eat you."
—Drulvurg, troll king

"Only a gargoyle would take such delight in a thunderstorm."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat
Only those who have nothing have nothing to fear.

"How ironic that the greatest forge of civilization is battle."
—Mangara

"Her beauty was the beauty of the Sun at midday, deadly to those who underestimated her strength."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

From you to me, so me to you.
—Femeref children's taunt
"Sorry I burned down your village. Here's some gold."
In the eastern reaches of Jamuraa are arrangements of massive stones. No one knows their origins—for certain.

"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*
It's good to know more about your enemy's fate than your enemy does.

"My minions serve me in the light; I serve no one."
—Shauku, Endbringer

Time is the one shackle you can't break.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

"Like Day from Night, / I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky, / because you cannot change, my dear, and nor can I."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"Water is like breathing—necessary for life."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger
Even wurms start out small.

Watching the windreaper
—Zhalfirin phrase meaning "daydreaming"

"I'll capture gentle zebras / for your steeds and fill the stable with every kind of unicorn."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

Trade to trade, not to keep.
—Suq'Ata motto

"The protection offered comes at a price. How numerous are your kin?"
—Purraj of Urborg

"Sun follows Moon until she tires, then carries her until she's strong / and runs ahead of him again."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

"Once, a wealthy king commissioned an artificial creature to be crafted from the royal treasury, thinking it a clever ploy to have the jewels guard themselves."
—Azeworai, "The Golem's Wish"

Pass me from soul to soul / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls.
—Totem inscription (translated)

"Eternal life or your money back."
—Unnamed Suq'Ata merchant, deceased

From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle
Few are able to underestimate the hordes.

"The creature rose from the mountain, its body weeping fire."
—Afari, *Tales*
Slow and heavy swings the club.

Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

"Let him be imprisoned while his possessions wander free."
—Suq'Ata legal decree
It scattered falcons like a lion hunting among jackals.
A cage may keep you in, but it does not keep the stones out.

"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

"Amazing thing, gravity. It seems to work every time."
—Telim'Tor

"People laughed at my darts—once."
—Telim'Tor
The three wizards knew only that this isle held a great mystery—and that patience alone would solve it.
If you think you're being watched, you're probably right.

"A pale bear shall herald the rise of the old gods."
—Gruul prophecy
Death is no reprieve from an Orzhov debt.
Crime doesn't pay nearly as well as the Agency.
Together, they're greater than the sum of their rap sheets.

"I honestly don't know if they're sabotaging our records or trying to help me sort."
—Kruno, Agency clerk
"Just one more thing . . ."

"The culprit doesn't seem to care about covering their tracks. Let's hope that's a good thing."
—Morska
Even experienced detectives can be strung along by planted evidence.
Most thought the Dimir had been wiped out. This suited the Dimir perfectly.
"You should really work on your aim."
The court of public opinion doesn't hear appeals.

"I prefer gasps and screams to polite applause."
—Judith
Where the victim's journey ends, the investigator's begins.
"Nice theory, but I'm going to have to poke some holes in it."
"Tremble, criminal, before the overwhelming might of meticulously organized evidence!"

His enthusiastic curiosity puts even the most fearsome of beasts at ease.

"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*
The best techniques outlive their creators.

"They had it coming."
—Squire Imalia, savior of Thiswick

"Ghirapur's gremlin population poses a threat to the infrastructure of the fairgrounds. Threats must be eliminated."
—Sram, senior edificer
Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.
To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.
As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.
Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

"Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing."
—Arima, lead inventor of the Futurists
The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.
"It's us against the world. Forever."

"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

"To halt these lurid practices, Geralf must be found and made an example of."
—Inquisitor Delmund
One way or another, everyone gets paid what they're owed.

"Body and spirit are sworn enemies. They will take any excuse to be rid of each other."
—Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
A blazing sun that never sets.
"The arc of my blade has carved a path of light for the peace that will follow."

"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must."
—Kaalia of the Vast

"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry
From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec
The mizzium-sphere array drove her mind deep into the thought field, where only the rarest motes of genius may be plucked.
Everyone has something to hide.
Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!
"Aha! This must be one of the ancient keys to... No, wait. It's just another puzzle toy."
"The specimen seems to be broken."

"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

"When all else fails, follow the geist's lantern."
—Vallon, Thraben inspector
Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan
Meeting one is definitely the low point of your life.

"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security
The indigo dragon gladly traded a bit of its hoard for everlasting moonlight.
He watches in silence as the shadows shift, bringing Amonkhet ever nearer to the Hour of Revelation.

"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?"
—Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi
It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

"Under the suns, Mirrodin kneels and begs us for perfection."
—Geth, Lord of the Vault
The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.
Death in form and function.
For a bittersweet moment, Jace believed he could still save his love. A moment was all Vraska needed. "For the glory of Phyrexia," she whispered.
Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

"You'd better be worth it."
—Liliana Vess

"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

"Throw that one back. I don't like how it's looking at me."
—Netos, Meletian fisherman

"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept
"Sure, I hear things. I hear plenty. But how am I to talk with this parched throat?"
"Why don't you come a little closer and say that again, you spineless spit-licker!"
Jingling coins beckon many an eager hand.
Dinner and politics don't mix.
The storm rages and the earth breaks.
Half the size, double the mayhem.
She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

"Gather your strength. Prepare yourself."
—Jeska, to Radha
Warning to those who scale the cliffs without paying tribute: It's a long way down.

"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion
"The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."

"Their keen sense of smell draws them to the unnatural. To find one is a boon."
—Veka, hinterland inspector
"Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."
When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.
From the cracks in the stone, she reads stories of the past. From the swirling vines, she glimpses visions of the future.
Silent as a snowdrift. Inexorable as an avalanche.
"The curse is broken."
He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

"Her voice is the wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte
Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.
If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade
"Even in death, we never stop growing."
Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain
Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .
Just assume every conversation is on record.

"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

City air is a constant drizzle of private thoughts.
"The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."
Automated systems at the Tolarian Academy sort new acquisitions for optimal use, determining which should be studied, eaten, or sold.
It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender
"Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

"Inspiration is found by looking outward."

"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"

"If that brain can't figure out the secret of the serum, then add more brains."
—Rhmir, Hand of the Augur

"Our stories define our reality."

Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo
Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.
Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.
The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.
Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.
On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.
When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.
Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist
A seething locus of reverent rage.
Amonkhet's desiccated land thirsts for blood.
On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.
When a werewolf changes for the first time, that first howl is said to echo through the wilds till moonset.

"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard
For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.
Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.
The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.
Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

"The Westfolk wept, and their tears wore winding rivers into the cheek of the world."
—Glem the Lonebard, "Origins of Kholon"

A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

"I was never here."

"If you're thinking only one step ahead, you're already falling behind."
